meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已写好或写了一半的小说导进写作项目,接着往下写
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有完本或半成品小说,想放进统一流程继续创作。
copy.tagline_en: Import your finished or half-written novel into a project and keep writing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a finished or half-written novel and want to keep writing it in one flow.

howto.what: 把已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析成可续写的项目结构：设定、大纲、正文、追踪，并按篇幅自动分流长篇或短篇两条路径；拆解与迁移产物分别落在拆文库和书名目录下。
howto.when: 当你说出 “/story-import”、“导入小说”、“反向解析” 等关键词，或询问“已有小说怎么续写”“导入流程先走哪一步”时接管。

say.text: 把我的书导进来，做成能接着续写的写作工程
say.note: 会先问你要导入哪本书、提供路径或贴原文

say.text: 导入这本小说，只要一份拆文库分析
say.note: 只跑拆解管道，不做结构迁移

say.text: 导入续写先走 story-setup 还是 story-import？
say.note: 先给推荐顺序，再收集原文

howto.what_en: Turns an existing novel (unfinished or complete) into a resumable project structure—settings, outline, chapters, tracking—routing long or short works down separate paths. Analysis and migration output land in the book directory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "/story-import", "导入小说", "反向解析", or ask how to continue an existing novel or which step comes first.

say_en.text: Import my book and turn it into a project I can keep writing
say_en.note: It first asks which book, path or pasted text
Runs the analysis pipeline, no structure migration

say_en.text: Should I run story-setup or story-import first?
say_en.note: Gives the order, then collects the source
